Document Vault

Store and retrieve project documents in a secure vault with version control and access restrictions.

artifacts

API router for the classified document vault and evidence attachment service.

This module exposes the endpoints for uploading, confirming, and downloading classified documents through the S3-compatible object store. All endpoints require JWT authentication and enforce ABAC clearance checks and export control interlocks.

Endpoints

POST /api/v1/artifacts/request-upload

Prepare artifact metadata and emit a pre-signed S3 PUT URL for upload.

POST /api/v1/artifacts/confirm-upload

Validate S3 object existence, verify SHA-256 digest, and mark artifact as active and available for download.

GET /api/v1/artifacts/{artifact_id}/download-url

Emit an authenticated pre-signed S3 GET URL valid for 60 seconds.

GET /api/v1/artifacts/

List all artifacts accessible to the current user based on clearance.

Security Considerations

  • All endpoints require a valid JWT token via the get_current_user dependency.

  • Upload requests are validated against the user’s clearance level — a user cannot upload a document classified above their clearance.

  • Download URLs are only issued after ABAC clearance and export control checks pass. URLs expire after 60 seconds to minimise data exfiltration risk.

  • Every download is logged in the ForensicAuditLog with the user’s identity and the artifact’s classification marking.

Usage

# Request an upload URL: POST /api/v1/artifacts/request-upload { “file_name”: “safety-report.pdf”, “file_size_bytes”: 1048576, “mime_type”: “application/pdf”, “security_classification”: “SECRET”, “export_control_regime”: “ITAR” }

# After uploading to the returned URL, confirm: POST /api/v1/artifacts/confirm-upload { “artifact_id”: “uuid…”, “sha256_checksum”: “abc123…” }

# Request a download URL: GET /api/v1/artifacts/{artifact_id}/download-url
